📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: July 19, 2026)

The Hanno Summer Festival, a cherished summer tradition, took place over two days—Saturday, July 18 and Sunday, July 19, 2026 (Reiwa 8)—drawing large crowds and much excitement.

On Sunday, July 19, the day of the main festival, I had the honor of appearing on Hanno Cable Television's broadcast of "Hanno Summer Festival 2026."

Throughout the city, ten neighborhoods showcased their vibrant festival floats with spirited musical performances. The powerful call-and-response chants that echoed through various parts of the city center captivated many visitors.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/shiseijoho/shichoshitsu/shichoblog/shisei2026/shisei202607/13955.html
